import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
fails=[]
def H(*extra, sid=0, **kw):
    pairs = [(":method", kw.get('method','GET')), (":scheme", kw.get('scheme','https')),
             (":authority", kw.get('authority','demo.test')), (":path", kw.get('path','/'))]
    pairs += [tuple(e) for e in extra]
    return hdr(sid, *pairs)
routes = {"https://demo.test":"shared","https://alt.test":"shared","http://demo.test":"other","https://z.test":"zzz"}
# FIN order != sid order: sid 8 commits first
events = [
  H(sid=8, authority='alt.test'),      # 0
  H(sid=0),                            # 1
  fin(8),                              # 2
  H(sid=4, scheme='http'),             # 3
  data(4, 'ff'),                       # 4
  fin(4),                              # 5
  fin(0),                              # 6
  unk(12),                             # 7
  data(16,'00'),                       # 8
  reset(20),                           # 9
  H(sid=24), fin(24), reset(24),       # 10,11,12 (extra events after terminal - ignored defensively)
]
r = run(scen(routes=routes, events=events))
print(json.dumps(r['streams'], indent=None))
exp_status = {0:'forwarded',4:'forwarded',8:'forwarded',12:'incomplete',16:'incomplete',20:'cancelled',24:'forwarded'}
for rec in r['streams']:
    if rec['status'] != exp_status[rec['sid']]: fails.append('sid %d status %r' % (rec['sid'], rec['status']))
# sids sorted
assert [x['sid'] for x in r['streams']] == sorted(x['sid'] for x in r['streams']), 'not sorted'
# offsets: shared pipeline should have sid8 first (offset 0), then sid0, then sid24
shared = raw(r,'shared')
by_sid = {x['sid']:x for x in r['streams']}
print('shared:', shared)
assert by_sid[8]['offset'] == 0
assert by_sid[0]['offset'] == by_sid[8]['length']
assert by_sid[24]['offset'] == by_sid[8]['length'] + by_sid[0]['length']
assert by_sid[24]['origin'] == 'shared'
assert by_sid[4]['origin'] == 'other' and by_sid[4]['offset'] == 0
assert r['origins']['zzz'] == ''
assert set(r['origins']) == {'shared','other','zzz'}
assert shared[by_sid[8]['offset']:by_sid[8]['offset']+by_sid[8]['length']] == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: alt.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
assert shared[by_sid[0]['offset']:by_sid[0]['offset']+by_sid[0]['length']] == b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
assert by_sid[8]['cache_key'] == ['GET','https','alt.test','/']
assert by_sid[4]['cache_key'] == ['GET','http','demo.test','/']
assert by_sid[4]['commit_at'] == 5
# empty scenario
r2 = run({"routes":{}, "events":[]})
assert r2 == {"streams":[], "origins":{}}, r2
r3 = run({"routes":{"https://a.test":"lab"}, "events":[]})
assert r3 == {"streams":[], "origins":{"lab":""}}, r3
# stream first seen at fin
r4 = run(scen(routes=routes, events=[fin(0), reset(4), data(8,'00'), unk(12)]))
assert [ (x['sid'],x['status']) for x in r4['streams'] ] == [(0,'rejected'),(4,'cancelled'),(8,'incomplete'),(12,'incomplete')], r4
print('FAILS', len(fails)); [print(' -',f) for f in fails]
EOF
python3 tmp/t6.py
